SETTING_KEYBOARD_TIP: 1–9 pick an option or a reward, Space the page's main action, Esc goes back. Every other key stays the game's.
SETTING_KEY_HINTS_TIP: The keycaps beside the options and rewards, and the key's segment on the buttons.
SETTING_SKIP_TIP: An NPC with a single option and no quests doesn't open the window: the option is picked. Hold Shift while talking to see the window.
SETTING_ALWAYS_TIP: Right-click an NPC's option to mark it: next time it is picked as you start talking. Hold Shift to see the list.
SETTING_ACCEPT_TIP: Picked: the quest you pick is accepted without its page. All: every quest the NPC offers is accepted as you start talking. Shift accepts nothing.
SETTING_COMPLETE_TIP: Picked: the finished quest you pick is handed in without its pages. All: every finished quest is handed in as you start talking. A reward to choose is always yours.
GROUP_TIP: A quest for a group of %d players
AUTO_MARK_TIP: Picked on its own (Right-click to unmark)
PVP_CONFIRM: Accepting this quest flags you for PvP.
KEYS_IN_COMBAT: In a fight the keys are the game's: use the mouse.
